name: Laga
source:
Story driven game / visual novel set in the ancient Middle East after the fall of the Tower of Babel. It's based off a visual novel style of gameplay in which there are no battles or points to be gained. The emphasis is on characters, stories, and exploration. 

[from [url=https://lagathegame.itch.io/laga]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事驱动的游戏/视觉小说以巴别塔倒塌后的古代中东为背景。它基于视觉小说的游戏风格，其中没有战斗或可以获得积分。重点是人物、故事和探索。

[来自[url=https://lagathegame.itch.io/laga]itch.io[/url]]
